description: This file contains asynchronous functions for evaluating JavaScript expressions and function calls within a debugger context using the chromiumoxide library. It includes error handling and formatting for exception details.

methods.name: evaluate_expression_in_debugger
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the debugger context and returns the deserialized output.

methods.name: format_exception_details
methods.description: Formats exception details into a human-readable string.

methods.name: evaluate_function_call_in_debugger
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript function call with arguments in the debugger context and returns the deserialized output.
